resources.string: Progress of the history backfill and of recomputing nights
A night that changed after Sleep as Android was asked to import it, and how to fix it there
Check a night in Sleep as Android
%1$s: the night now lasts %2$s–%3$s. When Sleep as Android was last asked to sync, it lasted %4$s–%5$s, and Sleep as Android never updates a night it imported.
%1$s: the night now lasts %2$s–%3$s. When Sleep as Android was last asked to sync, it was separate nights (%4$s), and Sleep as Android never updates a night it imported.

If Sleep as Android shows other times for this night, delete there every record with the cloud icon between %1$s and %2$s, and do not undo the deletion. Then tap “Recompute” on this night in PulseStages: once the night is complete, PulseStages asks Sleep as Android to import it again.

If Sleep as Android shows other times for this night, delete there every record with the cloud icon between %1$s and %2$s, and do not undo the deletion. Then tap “Sync now” in its Settings → Services, and again a few minutes later for the heart rate: with “Existing sessions” set to “Never overwrite”, “Recompute” in PulseStages rewrites nothing and so does not ask Sleep as Android to sync.
A night in Sleep as Android may be out of date
